verdict.rationale: Skyvern's browser sessions keep cookies, local storage, tabs and the current page between operations, so later steps resume where earlier ones stopped without losing state (skyvern-docs-21, skyvern-docs-10). Stored credentials and 2FA handling automate re-logging in (skyvern-docs-8), but that repeats the login rather than skipping it. Nothing documents named, reusable browser profiles that save an authenticated state and reuse it across separate future runs. Missing for 10: explicit persistent or reusable browser profiles across independent runs, documentation of session lifetime and reuse limits, hands-on corroboration.
